label: Bible Study
prompt: He shall cover thee with his _____, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verse: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
note: God as a mother bird — feathers for cover, truth for armor.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may _____ with you for ever;
verse: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
note: Jesus is leaving, but He promises another Comforter — one who will stay with them for ever.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they _____ left their nets, and followed him.
verse: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
note: 'Straightway' is the KJV's 'immediately' — Peter and Andrew left their nets on the spot and followed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and _____ have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verse: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
note: Asked his age by Pharaoh, Jacob gives a weary review of 130 years — few and evil.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of _____: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verse: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
note: Jesus' prelude to the parable of the rich fool: a man's life 'consisteth not' in the abundance of his possessions.
